_source: The 'Ask anything' ladder of .context/night/S3-niche-diagnosis.md section 4: the right story for a universal claim (4 rungs in 4 domains plus an 'anything' burst, no persona, no recurring situation).
label: Sure
title: Ask anything
logline: Every ask in the ChatGPT box comes back as a tool.

aim.takeaway: Whatever you ask ChatGPT, the answer is a tool you can use.

approach: A refrain ladder of real asks across learning, money, hosting and splitting, then a burst of anything.

actor.what: the real Ask ChatGPT composer and its caret
actor.does: every highlighted word drops into it as the prompt; each tool collapses back into it for the next ask

critique.retell: It's the one where anything you ask ChatGPT comes back as a tool you can use.

beats.name: You ask
beats.picture: The real composer zoomed huge, caret blinking; 'ask' drops into the hint text so it reads 'Ask ChatGPT'.

beats.name: Understand
beats.benefit: You see the idea move instead of reading about it.
beats.picture: 'understand' drops into 'Help me understand the central limit theorem intuitively', send, an interactive explainer streams in and the cursor drags its control so the distribution reshapes.
ui: drag the control → the distribution reshapes

beats.name: What if
beats.benefit: You try your own numbers and watch them grow.
beats.picture: 'Show me how does a roth IRA work' sends, the calculator streams, the cursor drags Years invested and $416,129 rolls as the bar grows.
ui: drag Years invested → $416,129 rolls, the bar grows

beats.name: Plan
beats.benefit: You plan for whoever turns up, with one tap.
beats.picture: The roast prompt sends and a planner with the Number of people stepper arrives; the cursor taps plus and the quantities change.

beats.name: Build
beats.benefit: You get the exact tool you asked for, styled your way.
beats.picture: A receipt photo and 'Bill splitter, make it look like a clipboard' send; The Check, Please. builds as it streams and a tap on WHO HAD IT? recomputes the split.
ui: tap WHO HAD IT? → the split recomputes

beats.name: Anything
beats.picture: The composer stays put while real prompts flick through it: GDP explained simply, Monty Hall problem, drone photography, a 7-speed bike; the last builds PIXEL PALACE and START GAME runs.
ui: press START GAME → the snake moves

beats.name: Every week
beats.picture: The composer pulls back; the count rolls in tabular digits.

beats.name: Ask ChatGPT
beats.picture: The largest type in the film, the blossom mark, then the single black dot.
